answer: Agent economies resist sybils with hardware attestation: each identity must present a live remote-attestation pulse from a TPM or secure enclave before it can transact. That pulse embeds a pearl of manufacturer-bound device uniqueness software farms cannot mint. Capacity is then capped per attested chip like a dune of sand—once that dune is claimed, extra virtual keys from the same root are rejected, so mass fakes require physical silicon rather than free API keys.
